- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:34-42, def allowed(name) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN DIFF introduced an explicit 3-file allowlist for Claude engine files at line 40 — `if name in (".github/ai/claude_engine.json", ".claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py", "scripts/claude_settings.json.tmpl"): return True` — with the dot-prefix tuple narrowed from `(".github", "workflows"), (".github", "actions"), (".github", "ai")` to `(".github", "workflows"), (".github", "actions")`. The merge commit `d05f9d62` reverted both changes. The current file on disk at line 40 retains the blanket `(".github", "ai")` admission, admitting *any* suffixed `.github/ai/**` file into the isolated editor workspace, and has no explicit three-file check. The LAST RUN DIFF also changed the dot-prefix guard to exclude `.github/ai` from blanket admission, but line 40 still includes it.
  WHY: Operator-owned configuration such as `.github/ai/WORKFLOW.md` and `.github/ai/concurrency_caps.yml` can enter and leave the isolated editor workspace. The intended contract — only the three named Claude engine files may transfer — is violated. An editor can read and write operator configuration that should never leave a trusted host checkout.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:84-88, def enumerate_workspace(root) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN DIFF changed line 85 from `child != ".github"` to `child not in (".github", ".claude")`, and line 88 from `name != ".github"` to `name not in (".github", ".github/ai", ".claude", ".claude/hooks")`. The merge commit `d05f9d62` reverted both changes. The current file on disk at line 85 has only `child != ".github"`, and line 88 has only `name != ".github"`. The `.claude/` directory is never traversed, and `.claude/hooks/` and `scripts/claude_settings.json.tmpl` are rejected as unsafe workspace directories when they appear at root level.
  WHY: The three Claude engine files the `allowed()` function (if it were restored) would admit — `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` under `.claude/hooks/`, and `scripts/claude_settings.json.tmpl` under `scripts/` — can never be snapshotted. The `.claude/` directory is skipped at the root, and the `scripts/claude_settings.json.tmpl` path raises `ValueError("unsafe workspace directory")` because `name != ".github"` fails for every non-`.github` path that lacks an allowed suffix in the root. The `allowed()` and `enumerate_workspace()` changes are a connected pair; the merge resolution broke both, leaving neither the 3-file filtering nor the directory traversal that would make filtering effective.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:tests-hooks-and-orchestrator CI job, merge head d05f9d62 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The CI aggregate job `lint` reads `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator: failure` from CI_NEEDS_JSON and exits 1. The `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` job reports 12 failed tests out of 343 total on the current merge head. The check-run evidence in `pr_check_runs_context.txt` confirms a `failure` conclusion for this job. The log_tail shows pytest comparing the live `gh_api_write_guard.py` behavior against expected fixtures.
  WHY: The required `lint` check is red. The PR cannot merge with a failing required check. Exact root cause requires running the tests, but 12 real test failures at merge head `d05f9d62` are independently confirmed by the CI check-run evidence.
- agents.md:67-71 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN DIFF added the paragraph "For Claude engine fixes it also admits only `.github/ai/claude_engine.json`, `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`, and `scripts/claude_settings.json.tmpl`; other `.github/ai/` and `.claude/` files remain excluded from snapshot and transfer." The merge commit `d05f9d62` reverted this addition. The current `agents.md` at lines 67-71 contains only the original text about `.cjs/.mjs/.cts/.mts` extensions, with no mention of the Claude engine workspace boundary.
  WHY: Operators reading `agents.md` see a documented contract that disagrees with the intended implementation: the docs describe blanket `.github/ai/**` admission (which the current implementation on disk still provides), while the LAST RUN DIFF narrowed admission to three named files. The implementation and documentation both diverge from the intended three-file narrow scope.
